payload.finding: §4 states the scheduler honours `recurrence` by counting ticks. The reference implementation (packages/core/src/execution-engine/scheduled-task-manager.ts) has NO tick counter; `intervalSize` appears only in the `summary` string and in `toCronKey`. The real everyX gating lives in nodes-base/nodes/Schedule/GenericFunctions.ts (lastExecution modulo arithmetic).
payload.impact: the scheduler is a pure timer registry; the port reproduces that
payload.suggested_action: amend §4 (or add a §5 non-responsibility) so no downstream lane re-implements recurrence counting here
